items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: he tore through that on that soprano like Grant went through Richmond.

ctx.x: Sometimes you can hear a little bit of that on some of his recordings, just a little.

That’s right. Because you see he came down to New Orleans to do a piece that Alvin Batiste had written for soprano, soprano and alto. And the soprano part was out so he said, “Kidd, you done studied, you know all this” you know how he was. On like the alto they’d be playing all them top register things, he’d go to California and he heard Ernie Watts and them were doing all this, and say, “you know how to do this,” you know like all up the horn and the soprano, he hadn’t been playing the soprano, but they gave it…
you’re doing.” You just wait, I’m gonna get ya. Now if he had done some of that, and the way he is, oh man, Lord have mercy.
